newsitem.title: GERMANY: DG Bank - not in talks to buy asset manager.
newsitem.headline: DG Bank - not in talks to buy asset manager.

text.p: DG Bank on Tuesday denied a German media report that it was in talks to buy U.S. asset manager Putnam Investments, a unit of insurance broker Marsh & McLennan Companies Inc, or a stake in Gabelli Investments, another U.S. mutual fund compnay.
But the bank reiterated that it was negotiating with several prospective Anglo-Saxon partners for a portfolio management unit it is setting up as a joint venture.
"At the moment we are in talks with internationally renowned asset managers to find a partner," a DG Bank spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
DG Bank earlier this month announced it was setting up a new Frankfurt-based unit, DG Trust Partner GmbH, aimed at capturing a share of the institutional investor market.
DG Bank said at the time it was in talks with two well-known institutions. The bank would not name potential partners but said a U.S. firm was on the short-list.

DG Bank has also said it would not follow the route taken by other German banks in buying a foreign asset management company because such a move would be too expensive, and integrating the acquisition often presented serious difficulties.
